messages:
Zara (Docs): While polishing the v1->v2 migration guide I found a tricky user story: if teams swap an embedding alias the vector dimensionality can change (eg 1024 -> 1536) and clients that assume a fixed dim will fail silently. We should add a short safety playbook + banner.
Diego (SDK): Agreed. Can you paste a minimal, truncated repro so we can include a snippet in the guide?
Zara (Docs): Truncated repro below (do NOT paste full vectors in docs):
```
POST /v2/embeddings
body: {\"model\": \"alias:embed-v2\", \"input\": \"hello\"}
response: {\"data\": [{\"embedding\": [ ...1536 floats... ]}]}
```
Hema (Product): Product wants 3 things: 1) short migration banner, 2) a 4-step checklist for safe rollout, 3) an FAQ line "Will my index break if dims change?" with next steps.
Diego (SDK): I'll add language-agnostic snippets for checking dims and a friendly SDK error. Example we can use in docs:
```
resp = client.embeddings.create(...)
dim = len(resp.data[0].embedding)
if dim != expected_dim:
    # helpful message for customers
    raise RuntimeError(f"embedding size {dim} != expected {expected_dim}. Pin model version or reindex.")
```
Owen (Infra): I'll add a `vector_dim` attribute to model-catalog and expose it via the /models endpoint (INF-983). That way docs can link directly to model dims.
Zara (Docs): Draft banner copy: "Warning: swapping an embedding model alias can change vector dimensionality. Verify embedding size before updating index schema." Short checklist in PR will include: 1) sample 1k queries, 2) compare dims, 3) pin alias or reindex, 4) ramp traffic.
Diego (SDK): SDK action: auto-check vector_dim on client init and warn when mismatch is detected. Will open SDK PR and unit tests.
Hema (Product): Also surface a short migration recipe in the deprecation notice for v1->v2 so customers see it during scheduling.
docs-bot: created task DOCS-1422 "embed-dim-safety-playbook" assigned to @Zara, @Diego, @Owen, @Hema due in 8 business days.
Zara (Docs): I'll open the docs PR and include JS/Python/Go snippets, the truncated example, and the FAQ bullet. PR link will be posted here when ready.
Owen (Infra): I'll post a telemetry snapshot in this thread after INF-983 lands; if impact >1% we should consider an automated migration helper.
Diego (SDK): Noted. When drafting snippets, let's avoid full arrays and use placeholders like `[...1536 floats...]`. Also ensure fenced code blocks use triple backticks.
Zara (Docs): Thanks all 389. I'll push an initial PR draft and ping reviews.
